note: Threshold demos for `python -m eval.demos --write` (from src/api). The MAXNOM limit is read from the loaded rule pack. Only ex_works_chf is changed, so that the non-originating share sits target_margin_pp below the limit (negative = above the limit, FAIL). The tool then checks that the single swap flips the verdict. Kept outside bom/demo/ because the API loads every *.json in that folder as a Product.

demos.story: FAIL just over the limit; buying the motor (L01) from a Swiss supplier flips it to PASS.
PASS just under the limit; moving the titanium body (L03) to a cheaper German supplier flips it to FAIL.
